text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the homeowners of 172 Donlea Drive to maintain an existing horizontal board on board wooden fence in the rear yard, which forms part of a swimming pool enclosure. The wood fence does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

That North York Community Council: 1. Granted the exemption to permit the homeowners of 172 Donlea Drive to maintain the existing horizontal board on board wooden fence in the rear yard that is part of a swimming pool enclosure, to be maintained in the same condition, without alteration. 2. Directed that, at such time as replacement of the fence is required, that the replacement fence will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
